atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Use the @tailwind directive to insert Tailwind's base, components, utilities and variants styles into your CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Use @apply to inline any existing utility classes into your own custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Use the @layer directive to tell Tailwind which "bucket" a set of custom styles belong to.

atDirectives.name: @variants
atDirectives.description: You can generate responsive, hover, focus, and other variants of your own utilities by wrapping their definitions in the @variants directive.

atDirectives.name: @responsive
atDirectives.description: You can generate responsive variants of your own classes by wrapping their definitions in the @responsive directive.

atDirectives.name: @screen
atDirectives.description: The @screen directive allows you to create media queries that reference your breakpoints by name instead of duplicating their values in your own CSS.

properties.name: scroll-behavior
properties.description: The scroll-behavior CSS property sets the behavior for a scrolling box when scrolling is triggered by the navigation or CSSOM scrolling APIs.

properties.name: backdrop-filter
properties.description: The backdrop-filter CSS property lets you apply graphical effects such as blurring or color shifting to the area behind an element.

pseudoClasses.name: :focus-visible
pseudoClasses.description: The :focus-visible pseudo-class applies while an element matches the :focus pseudo-class and the user agent determines via heuristics that the focus should be made evident on the element.
